meta.title: Skills & MCP Browser
meta.description: One floating ball opens a panel that turns your local skill library into something you can browse, search and govern: one/two-level categories plus custom groups (tree/flat views, manual groups, instant keyword grouping, AI auto-grouping with AI covers — grouping is view-only and never moves skill files), per-skill version badges with a "no version yet" fallback, per-card / per-category / library-wide enable-disable with automatic backups, and a full SKILL.md viewer. A call-ledger dashboard adds date ranges, day/week/month/year granularity, rankings, trend chart and failure details, fed automatically by the host's tools/result event. An MCP panel adds live MCP config and status, tool inventory with auto Chinese summaries, per-server call statistics, enable/disable and reconnect, plus standard mcpServers JSON export. One-click hot reload, all 128 ball skins contrast-adaptive, configurable skill root, draggable and resettable ball.. MCP management (live config/status/tools/call stats, enable/disable, reconnect, export, local MCP scan and AI fix); AI grouping ships with result cache and a progress timer.
